title: Director of National Labor Coordination
description:
National Technologies (NTI), a Network Connex Company, is a premier turnkey installer of fiber optic and data center infrastructure. Working on our team puts you on the leading edge of innovation in the digital communications space.

If being a part of a tight-knit organization that operates in some of the most advanced technology environments around the world sounds like a dream job, NTI might be the right fit for you! With the perks of a large organization, NTI remains true to its roots as a home-grown company with an open door culture that welcomes new ideas and encourages professional growth. We set you on the right path with careful onboarding and thorough training programs that prepare you for success in your role and beyond.

THE OPPORTUNITY

National Technologies is seeking a Director of National Labor Coordination to lead enterprise-wide planning, visibility, and allocation of field labor resources. This leader will create a national view of current and future labor demand and ensure the right people are positioned on the right projects at the right time.

Serving as the central coordination point for traveling field labor, this role works across programs, markets, project teams, and operations leadership to anticipate manpower needs before they become project emergencies. The role brings labor demand, employee capabilities, leadership needs, timing, geography, and future assignments together into one national strategy.

WHAT YOU WILL LEAD

• Maintain a forward-looking national labor-demand forecast across active and upcoming projects.

• Maintain visibility into available and committed field resources, including employees approaching demobilization and their next assignments.

• Coordinate mobilizations, demobilizations, transfers, and future assignments across projects, programs, markets, and geographic regions.

• Develop and maintain a comprehensive field skills registry covering employee experience, certifications, technical strengths, leadership capability, customer experience, travel availability, and project history.

• Match employee capabilities to project requirements, looking beyond job classifications alone.

• Identify future labor shortages, surpluses, and capability gaps before they affect project execution.

• Coordinate staffing requirements with project, program, and operations leadership.

• Manage critical traveling personnel as national organizational resources rather than isolated market resources.

• Forecast future recruiting and manpower requirements and coordinate leadership succession needs with National Labor Development.

• Provide executive leadership with labor forecasts, utilization information, risk assessments, and resource recommendations.

• Develop standardized manpower-request and forecasting processes, and challenge unsupported or excessive requests.

• Reduce unnecessary dependence on external labor through stronger internal resource planning.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Success in this role will be reflected in:

• Accurate national labor forecasts.

• Critical positions filled when required.

• Fewer emergency staffing requests.

• Improved utilization of internal employees.

• Reduced unnecessary use of external labor.

• Stronger skill-to-project matching.

• Greater visibility into future labor demand.

• Fewer resource conflicts between markets and programs.

WHAT YOU BRING

• Significant experience in construction operations, workforce planning, field operations, labor coordination, or large-project staffing.

• Strong understanding of construction labor requirements and field-leadership structures.

• Experience coordinating labor across multiple projects, markets, or geographic regions.

• The ability to evaluate employee capabilities beyond job classifications alone.

• Strong planning, forecasting, organizational, and analytical skills.

• The ability to manage competing priorities and resolve resource conflicts.

• Strong communication skills and credibility with both

title: Principal Engineer
description:
ABOUT MOTORWAY

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Hi, I'm Mariot, I lead Engineering here at Motorway. We're around 70 engineers across product teams, building the marketplace and all services around that handles hundreds of vehicle transactions every day. We care about delivering value to the business, getting the architecture engineering sound, keeping the production bar high, and being early and deliberate about the technology we adopt.

We have been early adopters of GenAI for software engineering, we've built a reputation for that, and we'd like to keep earning it. AI is enabling us to deliver faster at a much higher quality software while easing the maintenance of our existing services.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Principal Engineer to set technical direction and evolve engineering practices across Motorway, reporting to the Director of Engineering. This is a broad role: your remit spans multiple product areas and every engineering specialties, and your decisions will shape what we build, what we buy, and what we retire.

You'll work with engineering leadership, product, and other functions stakeholders to continuously evolve our overall architecture and practices, and with our senior and staff engineers to turn that direction into working software.

You will own our relationships with AWS on the engineering side, our main cloud provider. It's the foundation of our platform and one of our most important partnerships. In practice, we expect you to lead the following activities:

- Frequently meet AWS representatives getting access to latest services and features, share feedback on our usage and needs, and be an early tester and adopter of new services/

- Identify new services we could adopt to continuously improve our reliability and ability to build new services and features at pace for the business.

- Share internally good practices on software engineering at the edge and usage of AWS services, including continuously updating technical recommendations for humans and agents.

You'll represent Motorway on stage at external events and in the wider engineering community, and you'll set the standard for how engineers here present their work internally.

You'll also lead on our adoption of AI for software engineering. We give engineers access to the latest models through Kiro, and we want someone who can define what good looks like when domain depth, AI-enabled breadth, and rigorous evaluation all have to work together.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Set technical strategy across multiple product areas, and make the commercial case for it to leadership with data rather than assertion

- Identify cross-cutting architectural risks and resolve them before they block us at scale

- Set engineering standards, architectural patterns, and documentation norms, including the writing precision that makes specs reliable inputs for both engineers and agent systems

- Raise the reliability, observability, and security bar across engineering: SLO philosophy, incident management standards, production readiness, and threat models that hold up in the AI era

- Be a force of innovation on AI for Software Engineering.: Monitor our LLM usage, latest models trial and evaluation, technical debt modernisation through AI agents.

title: Engineering Generalist, R&D
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE R&D TEAM

Fluidstack's R&D organization designs the next generations of our data center product: modular builds, new cooling and power architectures, and the lab-to-field pipeline that turns prototypes into deployable capacity. The team spans mechanical, electrical, controls, and compute engineering, working with manufacturing and supply chain to move designs from first article to repeatable production at gigawatt scale.

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Running several first-of-a-kind power and cooling pilots at once without letting any of them stall.

- Keeping every engineering team pointed at the same priorities as the product and the company change quickly.

- Getting the data in front of leadership fast enough to make technical bets with confidence.

ROLE SCOPE

- Be the right hand to the Head of Development Engineering. Work side by side with the head of R&D, take their highest-priority problems off their plate, and drive each one to a decision or a delivered result.

- Drive initiatives across the organization. Own cross-team efforts from first scoping to done, and do whatever the work needs, from analysis and vendor calls to schedules and follow-up, so the team moves fast.

- Coordinate across every engineering team. Work directly with each engineering team and its leader to line up projects, pilots, and R&D efforts so priorities, owners, and dates stay clear.

- Shape technical direction. Build the first-order analysis leadership needs to set the company's technical direction, and carry decisions back into the teams that execute them.

- Run the operating rhythm. Own the R&D leadership cadence: agendas, decisions, action items, and status reports that name what is slipping and what it takes to recover.

Key Responsibilities Conduct comprehensive patient assessments in the home setting. Develop, implement, and update individualized care plans based on patient needs. Educate patients and caregivers regarding medications, treatments, disease processes, and safety measures. Coordinate care with physicians, therapists, social workers, and other members of the healthcare team. Ensure compliance with agency policies, Medicare guidelines, and professional nursing standards. Maintain timely and accurate clinical documentation within the electronic medical record system. Participate in interdisciplinary case conferences and care coordination meetings. Support quality improvement initiatives and patient satisfaction goals. Respond appropriately to patient needs and changes in health status. Ability to work independently and manage multiple patient visits efficiently. Reliable transportation and valid driver's license. Current CPR certification or ability to obtain upon hire. Proficiency with electronic medical record systems and documentation. Preferred Qualifications Two or more years of Home Health nursing experience. Wound care certification or advanced clinical training. Bilingual abilities (English/Spanish) preferred. Experience working with geriatric and medically complex patients. BSN preferred but not required. Physical Requirements Ability to travel frequently between patient homes within the assigned service area. Ability to stand, walk, bend, kneel, and reach during patient visits. Ability to lift, transfer, or assist patients as needed, up to 50 pounds with appropriate support. Ability to use nursing equipment and perform clinical procedures safely. Ability to sit for extended periods while completing documentation. Visual acuity sufficient to assess patients and review medical records. Manual dexterity required for documentation, medication administration, and nursing procedures. Ability to communicate effectively with patients, caregivers, and healthcare professionals. Ability to work in varying home environments and conditions.

title: Product Counsel
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As Product Counsel, you will be a hands-on legal partner to the teams building Claude for consumers and businesses. You'll work across Claude's apps, subscriptions, growth programs and enterprise offerings, moving to wherever the need is greatest. You'll learn from experienced product lawyers, get close to the product quickly, and take on more ownership as you go. This is a generalist role for someone who wants range, likes a fast pace, and is ready to do the routine work and the novel work with the same care.

Key responsibilities

• Partner with Product, Engineering, Design and other cross-functional teams to give clear, practical legal guidance from early ideas through launch

• Review product launches across Claude's consumer and enterprise offerings, spotting issues early and helping teams find a path forward

• Advise on subscriptions, pricing, promotions, billing and other growth programs, including consumer protection and marketing rules

• Support enterprise and regulated-industry products on topics such as admin controls, customer commitments and enterprise readiness

• Draft and review user-facing terms, disclosures, in-product copy and marketing claims

• Pull in privacy, commercial, IP, safety and other specialists, then return one integrated answer to your product partners

• Build guides, templates and AI-powered workflows so routine questions get answered quickly and the team can focus on novel ones

• Pick up new areas as priorities shift, and help with incidents and escalations when they come up

Minimum qualifications

• Hold a law degree (JD, LLB, or equivalent) and meet the local licensing requirements to work as in-house counsel where you'll be based

• At least 4 years of relevant legal experience, with exposure to technology, consumer or regulated products

• Experience advising business or product teams directly, not only other lawyers

• Working knowledge of at least two of: consumer protection, privacy, advertising and marketing law, technology transactions, IP, or regulated industries

• Curiosity about how AI products work, and the ability to pick up technical concepts quickly

• A habit of making a clear recommendation, even with incomplete information

• Comfort moving between assignments as priorities change, with no job too big or too small

• Clear, concise writing that non-lawyers can act on

• Openness to feedback and a track record of improving quickly

• Experience using AI tools in your legal work, or a strong interest in learning to do so

• Empathy and a service orientation, with a real commitment to Anthropic's mission

Preferred qualifications

• In-house product counsel experience, or a secondment with a product team

• Experience with subscription businesses, promotions, or consumer billing

• Experience supporting enterprise SaaS or regulated customers such as healthcare or financial services

• Experience building playbooks, self-serve guidance or legal automation

description:

We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to own the data behind a campaign-management platform that will manage paid search and paid social campaigns across well over a thousand Google Ads and Meta accounts for automotive dealerships, replacing a third-party tool the client licenses today.
This is an integration-heavy data role. You will connect the platform to the client's own business data: Salesforce budgets and enrollments, daily vehicle inventory in Snowflake, dealer offers and incentives, and manufacturer enrollment files. That data decides how much each campaign may spend, which dealer it belongs to and which vehicles and offers it promotes. You will also prove that each migration wave moved cleanly, and run production operations while the book moves.
Responsibilities
Build the data foundations

• Build the Salesforce budget sync: read budget line items and enrollments without ever writing them, hold any campaign with no matching line item, keep the two budget families strictly separate, and hold rather than proceed when Salesforce is unreachable.

• Build the dealer crosswalk that links each dealer to its Google Ads account, Meta account, Salesforce record and inventory feed, with the attributes the platform filters and routes on, a standing exception report and automatic onboarding of new enrollments. Never resolve an ambiguous match by guessing.

• Ingest daily VIN-level inventory from Snowflake, offers from S3 feeds and an offers API, and manufacturer enrollment files, with freshness and completeness checks that stop downstream work on stale data.

• Agree the data contracts with the client's data team in Sprint 0, and use the shared contracts the platform pod publishes for inventory, offers and incentives where they cover the same feeds.

• Build pacing detection: current-day spend from the ad platforms, month-end projection from remaining eligible days, and flags a strategist can understand.

• Build the Incentive Sync engine: offers and their expiry in one approval, validated per account against manufacturer rules, removed exactly once on expiry.

• Model manufacturer rules, allowed values and model lineups as versioned, effective-dated data, and supply dealer and inventory data to the playbook renderer and to inventory-driven campaign selection.

Prove and move the book

• Build wave orchestration and the evidence pipeline: fourteen-day before-and-after aggregates, ID checks, settings diffs, tracking audit and zero-spend checks, assembled into a scorecard the client signs.

• Produce the data for the pilot wave in month five. The client uses that evidence to decide whether to give notice to its current tool.

• Run the data side of five production waves: bind every adopted campaign to its budget, carry over settings held only in the current tool, audit and fix inherited tracking parameters, and calibrate pacing on live spend.

Run it and hand it over

• Run production operations during the migration: observability tuning, incident response, API quota monitoring and rollback drills, coordinated with the platform pod's on-call for the shared environments.

• Hand pipelines, runbooks, environments and data contracts to the client's teams, and confirm the handover by having them run it.

• Write decision records, runbooks and documentation the client's data team can work from, and pair with their engineers throughout.

Because the team is small, also

• Run the data working sessions with the client's data team and Salesforce administrators yourself, and leave with written agreements.

• Make reversible data design decisions when the Solutions Architect is unavailable, write them down and bring them for review.

• Prepare the data side of every wave sign-off pack, and act as first responder for data issues during the migration.

• Raise blockers early and in writing, with an impact assessment on schedule, scope or quality.

title: Support & QA Specialist, Tax
description:
This role is fully remote, open to candidates based anywhere in the United States outside New York, with a preference for the Pacific or Mountain time zones. Based in New York? Apply to the New York posting of this role instead.
A Different Kind Of Job Description
At Filed , we believe in radical transparency. Everything is open: company finances, team salaries, stock options, anonymous team feedback. That extends to how we talk about this job. So instead of a list of perks, we'll start with what's genuinely hard about it, then tell you why it might be the best move you'll make.
What's hard about this job
Bugs don't arrive with instructions. A customer tells you "it didn't work." Your job is to work out exactly what they did, with which return, in which tax software, and make it happen again on your own screen. If you can't reproduce it, engineering can't fix it.
Your ticket is the fix's starting point. Engineers will build from what you write. Vague steps mean days of back and forth while a firm waits. You'll need to be precise every time.
The pace is fast. Our customers are tax firms in their busiest weeks. When something breaks, they need an answer today, and a workaround while the real fix is built.
It isn't fixed until you've checked. You'll retest every fix before telling a customer it's resolved, and you'll recheck after releases that nothing else broke.
Why it might be the best career move you'll make
You'll sit between customers and engineering. Few roles see both sides this clearly. You'll learn how real firms use tax software, and how software actually gets built.
Your work ships. A bug you reproduce on Monday becomes a fix every firm on Filed benefits from. A workaround you find saves a firm hours the same day.
You'll grow as fast as we do. Filed is adding millions of dollars of revenue every quarter, and the support and QA function is still small. People who start here move into QA, product and engineering-adjacent roles.
We've raised $17.2 million to date, led by Northzone, and we work with tax firms across the country, from regional practices to some of the biggest names in the profession.
What You'll Own

• Reproducing customer-reported issues step by step, inside Filed and the tax software firms already use

• Writing clear, complete Linear tickets with exact steps, expected versus actual results, screenshots and sample data, so engineers can act straight away

• Answering customer tickets quickly and clearly in our support inbox

• Troubleshooting technical issues and finding workarounds that keep firms moving

• Verifying fixes before they go back to the customer, and regression testing after releases

• Spotting patterns across tickets and flagging them before they spread

Your Hard Skillset

• Hands-on QA or software testing experience: you've reproduced bugs and written them up for an engineering team

• Customer support experience in a ticketing system such as Pylon, Zendesk, Intercom or Freshdesk

• A tax background, either at a tax or accounting firm, at a tax software company, or preparing returns yourself. You don't need to be a preparer, but you should know your way around a return.

• Familiarity with at least one major tax platform, such as CCH Axcess, UltraTax, Lacerte, ProConnect, Drake or GoSystem

• Bonus if you've used Linear or Jira, browser developer tools or screen recording to capture issues

Your Soft Skillset

• Methodical: you change one thing at a time until you find what breaks

• Clear writing: your tickets and replies leave no room for confusion

• Curious: you want to know why something broke, not just that it did

• Calm and patient with customers who are under deadline pressure

• You take ownership and follow a problem through to the fix

Who This Suits

• People who enjoy hunting down a problem more than answering the same question twice

• Support professionals who want to move into QA and product

• Tax professionals who want to move into tech without leaving their expertise

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Develop and operate our Agent Platform for deploying, running, evaluating, governing, and improving agents and agentic workflows.

- Build and operate agents and workflows that carry engineering work from issue to production and business work from trigger to outcome, with humans governing the boundaries.

- Own our Developer Infrastructure (Source Control and CI) and build the developer tools that improve builder flow and reduce friction across the company.

- Partner with teams across Engineering, Product, Sales, and G&A to understand where AI could accelerate their work or improve the quality of outcomes.

- Drive adoption of agents and agentic tooling across the company, and own the best practices and enablement materials that help builders succeed using the paved roads.

- Build measurement and feedback loops (usage, reliability, and cost) to quantify the productivity the platform unlocks and guide the roadmap.

- Treat Temporal as customer zero: turn what we learn into validated requirements for Temporal Cloud, the SDKs, and our Agent Harness, and contribute to an open-source reference architecture that customer platform teams can adopt.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

- Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience shipping and operating production-quality internal platforms or developer tooling.

- Experience leveraging modern agentic coding tools such as Codex and Claude Code.

- Proficiency in one or more programming languages commonly used at Temporal, such as Go, TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, or Java.

- Experience building workflow automation or internal tools (CLI tools, services, GitHub automation, cloud automation, or similar).

- Strong judgment about when to standardize versus when to enable flexibility, and how to remove friction without compromising reliability.

- Comfort working cross-functionally, including partnering with non-traditional developers and translating needs into usable solutions.

- Ability to use data and qualitative feedback together to prioritize and measure impact.

- Clear written communication, including documentation that enables self-service.

NICE TO HAVES

- Experience building internal agents and operating an agent platform

- Experience building and operating Temporal applications.

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing - and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to partner with our R&D organization. Samsara's R&D organization creates the industry-leading IoT products and features that power our customer experience. You will partner with our engineering leaders, driving quantitative and qualitative analysis to identify cost optimization opportunities. You will help build the reporting and attribution frameworks needed to track and govern AI spend, support month-end close procedures, and drive forecast models that give our leaders and investors accurate guidance. The ideal candidate is highly self-motivated, analytical, and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Canada. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact - helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.

• Partner with Accounting on month-end close activities, cost classification, and reporting requests.

• Collaborate with R&D teams to drive AOP planning.

• Improve the accuracy and scalability of existing financial reporting and forecasting models.

• Develop new mechanisms, analysis, or KPIs to inspect business performance.

• Leverage AI tools to streamline financial reporting, forecasting, and ad hoc analysis workflows.

• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

This helps us improve the user experience and evolve their operational tactics and techniques. And if something isn’t quite right, we work with product teams to quickly address the issue on behalf of our customer.

Grow your business through customer success. In addition to the operational and executive relationships you own, you will be responsible for meeting commercial targets that drive top line growth. Shape our products to meet mission needs. About the Role
Most companies in data and AI sound the same. The same launch recaps, the same borrowed talking points, the same claims no one checked. This role exists so phData doesn't. You turn what our R&D experts and executives know into original, fact-checked journalism that reporters quote, analysts cite, and buyers trust. You are one person working with roughly 10 subject-matter experts and executives, and you don't have a team to hide behind. If you do this poorly, phData publishes content that is forgettable at best and wrong at worst, in a market where credibility is the whole game.
About You
Read this section like a mirror, not a checklist. Some of it is meant to make you nod. Some of it is meant to make you uncomfortable. Both reactions are useful, to you and to us.

• You've killed a story you loved because one source wouldn't confirm it. You didn't publish and hope.

• You've told a senior executive their idea wasn't original enough to run, and kept the relationship.

• Journalist first. You report, interview, verify, and edit like someone whose name is on the byline. You consider "good enough to publish" a failure of standards, not a deadline.

• Quiet ownership. Your best work goes out under an SME's or executive's name. You are fine with that, and you still defend its quality as if it were yours.

• Judgment over volume. You pick one flagship idea a quarter and say no to the rest. You don't measure yourself by how much you shipped.

• Translator. You can sit with an R&D lead who is explaining agent orchestration, ask the question that exposes the real insight, and then explain it to a reporter in two sentences.

• Relationship builder. You earn attention from reporters and analysts by being useful and accurate, not by pitching harder.

If none of that landed, this probably isn't your role, and that's fine. If more than a couple did, keep reading.
What You'll Own
Original content

• Run the idea pipeline: collect ideas from R&D SMEs and executives, evaluate them for originality, and select one flagship idea each quarter with an executive sponsor.

• Report and write the flagship article, including interviews, source confirmation, and fact-checking.

• Deliver the full flagship package to marketing: article, source file, quote bank, data points, and fact-check log.

Momentum content

• Maintain a list of trusted sources and identify relevant topics every week to produce digests and perspectives in an engaging voice.

• Monitor launches from key companies (for example, Anthropic, Snowflake, and AWS) and publish timely takes that connect to client value.

Public relations

• Build and maintain targeted media lists. Pitch flagship articles as news stories and answer journalist inquiries with expert commentary.

• Facilitate bylined pieces under SME and executive names, provide media training, and manage press releases and spokesperson me

Baseten is building a new cloud for AI. Our ambition is to make inference, training, and agent execution part of one coherent platform, and to shape how the next generation of AI products gets built. Product decisions here reach from the economics of GPU infrastructure to the abstractions developers build on every day.

We’re hiring builders and tastemakers with the ambition to help create that future. You should bring a strong point of view about what should exist, the taste to make complex technology feel simple, and the technical judgment to build it alongside engineers, researchers, and designers. You’ll work directly with customers and forward deployed teams, turn emerging capabilities into new possibilities for developers, and carry an idea from early conviction through to production and adoption.

THE ROLE

Make AI inference faster, smarter, and more efficient at scale.

Making AI models faster and cheaper is one of the most important engineering challenges in the industry. But a faster runtime alone isn't enough. Customers need to understand what improved, whether it works for their models, and how to take advantage of it in production.

- Make performance features easier to configure, evaluate, and adopt in production.

- Help customers understand tradeoffs across hardware, model configurations, autoscaling, and routing.

- Partner with engineering on release readiness, compatibility, and regression testing so customers can trust new capabilities.

REQUIREMENTS

- Experience building and shipping AI/ML products or infrastructure, particularly where performance, scalability, or production behavior mattered.

- Strong understanding of model serving architectures, GPU economics, and latency, throughput, quality, and cost tradeoffs.

- Experience working closely with researchers or infrastructure engineers to bring technically complex capabilities into production.

- A rigorous approach to benchmarking, experimentation, and performance measurement.

- Strong product judgment and the ability to translate deep technical work into clear customer value.

NICE TO HAVE

- Hands-on experience with PyTorch, vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang, NVIDIA Dynamo, or similar technologies.

- Experience with open-source inference projects, model optimization, or ML systems research.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Customers can take advantage of Baseten's latest inference optimizations without becoming experts in the underlying run

• Apply AI-assisted techniques to log analysis, correlation, anomaly detection, enrichment, and investigation support.

• Understanding of modern cloud and distributed architectures.

title: Digital Measurement & Analytics Specialist
description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. For more information, visit wppmedia.com .

Sobre a Vaga
Procuramos um(a) Especialista em Digital Measurement & Analytics para integrar a nossa equipa de tecnologia e dados na WPP - o maior grupo global de transformação de marketing e comunicação.

Nesta função, terás autonomia para liderar projetos de ponta a ponta: desde o levantamento de requisitos e implementação técnica (DataLayer, GTM, RGPD) até à validação, entrega e apoio analítico às equipas de media e performance. Principais Responsabilidades

• Gestão e Entrega de Projetos: Conduzir projetos de medição técnica com autonomia, fazendo a ponte entre clientes, equipas de desenvolvimento e equipas de media.

• Implementação & Tag Management: Configurar, testar e manter tags, pixels e eventos via Google Tag Manager (Web e apoio a implementações Server-Side), assegurando a conformidade com o RGPD e Consent Mode.

• Planos de Medição & DataLayer: Desenvolver e documentar planos de medição e especificações de DataLayer (Web/App), garantindo boas práticas de taxonomia e parametrização de URLs (UTMs).

• Análise & Apoio a Media: Extrair e analisar dados no GA4 para otimização de conversão e apoiar as equipas de Performance na leitura de campanhas e modelos de atribuição digital.

• Visualização & Qualidade de Dados: Criar protótipos de dashboards em Looker Studio para validar novas estruturas de dados, articulando com a equipa de BI para implementações contínuas e auditando a qualidade/consistência dos dados.

• Partilha Técnica: Apoiar o dia a dia da equipa, partilhar boas práticas de medição e colaborar na documentação técnica.

O Que Procuramos

• Experiência: 2 a 4 anos em funções de Web Analytics, Digital Measurement ou implementação de Tracking.
Google Marketing Platform: Domínio prático e avançado de GA4 (Web/App) e Google Tag Manager (Web e Server-Side).

• Autonomia & Debugging: À-vontade para diagnosticar erros, testar implementações de tags e validar fluxos de dados no DataLayer.

• Media & Atribuição: Compreensão de campanhas de media paga, atribuição digital e cruzamento de métricas digitais com MMM.

• Privacidade & RGPD: Conhecimento de consentimento digital (Consent Mode) e estratégias de dados First-Party.

• Visualização de Dados: Experiência prática na criação de dashboards e protótipos em Looker Studio (ou Power BI / Tableau).

• Perfil: Sentido de responsabilidade (ownership), rigor analítico e excelente comunicação com clientes e equipas multidisciplinares.

O Que Valorizamos 

• Conhecimentos de SQL e experiência com Google BigQuery para análise e modelação de dados.

• Noções de programação em Python ou R aplicados a marketing analytics.

• Familiaridade com ferramentas e conceitos de IA / Ciência de Dados aplicados a analytics.

• Experiência de integração com plataformas de CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce) e dados omnicanal.

• Experiência com MMPs (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch) para tracking aplicacional.

• Certificações oficiais Google (Analytics, GCP, etc.).

 

O Que Oferecemos :

• Seguro de Saúde desde o 1º dia.

- 3-5 years in influencer marketing, talent management or campaign management

- A solid grasp of how influencer campaigns run end to end

- Creator negotiation and contracting experience, including usage rights

- Campaign experience
